Name: Dulling Chains
Description: You summon a magical restraint to ensnare an enemy. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d4 force damage, and its speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.
At Higher Levels: The spell creates more than one restraint when you reach higher levels: two restraints at 5th level, three restraints at 11th level, and four restraints at 17th level. You can direct the restraints at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each restraint.
